Dimensions/anchor below are real measured values, not disabled-draft sentinels. minSpacing/placementWeight stay 0 for the same reason as every other master in this family: no procedural pool exists, this record must not enter a runtime pool on its own — the composer weight used at runtime comes from productionClaims()/propRole() in game.js, not from this field.

notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, umbrella-open-cart right-edge master. Session 48 applied the deterministic style-correction pipeline used on the rest of the family (see this file's prior revision for that trail). Session 60 re-inspected the corrected v002 binary and confirmed it clean (near-binary alpha, corner alpha 0, no baked background) but flagged it not yet registered pending a controlled measurement pass. This is that pass, Session 61. Own-pixel measurements, not copied from any other def: canvas 573x937 (matches the Session-48 note's claim, re-verified directly rather than trusted). Raw alpha>=32 bbox is (102,219)-(469,676), but connected-component analysis shows the MAIN component (95,835px) only reaches (102,219)-(469,674) - the extra 2px at the bottom belong to two single-pixel dust islands at (262,675) and (257,676), sitting just below the real silhouette. Those are excluded here as dust, not cart geometry - visualBounds.y1 is 674, not the raw bbox's 676. Two other stray pixels (2px total) sit at y=616-617, well inside the bbox, and never extend it. v001's equivalent scan found 38 components / 62px of comparable dust, so the Session-48 alpha cleanup measurably reduced it here too. Handedness verified from pixel structure, not filename: display case, food trays and open shelving sit on the LOW-x (left, ~x102-295) side of the canvas; gas cylinder and the wood push-handle sit on the HIGH-x (right, ~x400-469) side - matching the validated fixed-canopy-right v002 master's service-low-x/storage-high-x convention, the mirror of the left umbrella-cart master. Cross-checked against the left master (different umbrella colour layout, different wheel configuration - three plain casters here vs one large spoked wagon wheel plus two casters there) to confirm these are genuinely separate renders, not one file's mirror. No baked directional ground-contact shadow found: the same soft ~4px alpha halo that rings the wheels in the already-shipped fixed-canopy-right master (verified by side-by-side crop) rings the wheels here too - the family's standard alpha-cleanup dilation artifact, not a shadow defect. Footprint identified by the same alpha-column-scan methodology as the left master, mirrored: the stable counter/panel band above y~605 (x range ~301px wide across y=534-589) gives way to the wheel silhouette around y~609 (x0 recedes off the panel's 113-119, dips briefly, restabilizes at 114-117). Two convergence samples: y=610 gives (115,394), y=612 gives (117,395) - 1-2px drift, confirming a real structural edge. footprint = (114,609)-(395,674). cropSafe = visualBounds +/-48px, clamped to canvas = (54,171)-(517,722); real canvas margins (54/171/104/262px L/T/R/B) run well past the 48px minimum on every side, same not-tightly-cropped pattern as the left master and the fixed-canopy-right source. pivot = road_facing_ground_contact_centre: x = footprint's road-facing (left, low-x) boundary = 114, matching alignTo: road_facing_edge_left; y = footprint.y1 = 674 (ground line). heightPx set to 70, matching every other master in this family. Geometry contract (Session 56): scale s = 70/(674-219) = 0.15385; roadFacingVisX = visualBounds.x0 = 102 (this is a right-edge master, road-facing side is low-x); roadIntrusion = |pivot.x - roadFacingVisX| * s = |114-102| * 0.15385 = 1.85px against the 8px hard cap - PASS, comfortably within the 5.6px preferred-guidance band. rho (source-px intrusion ratio) = 12/455 = 0.02637; declared maximum runtime height before the hard cap fails = 8/0.02637 = 303.3px, far above the 70px shipped value. Registered as EDGE_PROP_DEFS.mumbai_vadapav_cart_umbrella_open_cart_right and added to PRODUCTION_CATALOGUE_KEYS alongside the fixed-canopy pair; runtime day/night render, console-clean status and composer/cache regression are recorded in CHANGELOG.md's Session 61 entry, not duplicated here. Not yet PM-reviewed for visual/creative sign-off - status held at 'review', not 'approved', consistent with the fixed-canopy-left v003 gate. Supersedes mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_umbrella_open_cart_right_neutral_1x_v001, kept unmodified on disk for traceability.
